        footer.setObjectName("footer")
        footer.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        card_layout.addWidget(footer)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.card)

    def _load_logo(self):
        logo_path = _find_logo()
        if logo_path and logo_path.exists():
            pixmap = QPixmap(str(logo_path))
            self.logo.setPixmap(
                pixmap.scaled(
                    108,
                    108,
                    Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                    Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
                )
            )
        else:
            self.logo.setText("VSH\nNEWS")

    def _toggle_password(self):
        if self.pass_input.echoMode() == QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password:
            self.pass_input.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal)
            self.eye_button.setText("Hide")
        else:
            self.pass_input.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
            self.eye_button.setText("Show")

    def _handle_exit(self):
        self.close()
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app is not None:
            app.quit()

    def _handle_login(self):
        username = self.user_input.text().strip()
        password = self.pass_input.text()
        if not username or not password:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Validation Error", "Please enter both username and password.")
            return
        self.login_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.login_button.setText("AUTHENTICATING...")
        self.status_label.setText("Verifying credentials...")
        try:
            session = self._auth.login(username, password)
        except AuthError as ex:
            self.status_label.setText(str(ex))
            self.pass_input.clear()
            self.pass_input.setFocus()
        except Exception:
            self.status_label.setText("")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Login Error", "An unexpected authentication error occurred.")
        else:
            self.status_label.setText("Authentication successful.")
            self.user_input.clear()
            self.pass_input.clear()
            self.authenticated.emit(session)
        finally:
            self.login_button.setEnabled(True)
            self.login_button.setText("LOGIN")

class MainWindow(QMainWindow):
    logged_out = Signal()

            "VSH NEWS TV — Main System | Visionary Baluchistan Media Corporation (Pvt) Ltd"

        self.resize(1440, 900)
        self.setMinimumSize(1100, 700)

        self._dashboard = DashboardView(session)
        self._dashboard.module_requested.connect(self._open_dashboard_module)

        brand = QLabel("VSH NEWS TV")
        brand.setObjectName("brand")

        company = QLabel("Visionary Baluchistan\nMedia Corporation (Pvt) Ltd")
        company.setObjectName("company")

            f"Role: {session_role_label(session)}"
        )

        whoami.setWordWrap(True)

        self._nav = QListWidget()
        self._nav.setObjectName("nav")
        sidebar_items = [

            "Vouchers",
            "Trial Balance",
            "Ledger",
            "Attendance",
            "Users & Roles",
            "Backup Database",
            "Exit",
        ]
        for item in sidebar_items:
            self._nav.addItem(item)
        self._nav.setCurrentRow(0)
        self._nav.itemClicked.connect(lambda it: self._open_dashboard_module(it.text()))

        logout = QPushButton("Log out")
        logout.setObjectName("logout")
        logout.clicked.connect(self._logout)

        side.addWidget(logout)

        central = QWidget()
        central.setObjectName("shell")
        row = QHBoxLayout(central)
        row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        row.setSpacing(0)
        row.addWidget(panel)
        self._stack = QStackedWidget()
        self._stack.addWidget(self._dashboard)
        row.addWidget(self._stack, 1)
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        status = QStatusBar()
        status.showMessage(

            QListWidget#nav::item:hover { background: #4B1427; }
            QPushButton#logout {
                margin: 10px 14px; padding: 10px; color: #FFFFFF;
                background: #6A2038; border: 1px solid #C8A96B;
                border-radius: 7px; font-weight: 700;
            }
            QPushButton#logout:hover { background: #842B49; }
            QStatusBar { background: #0F172A; color: #F8FAFC; border-top: 1px solid #DC2626; font-size: 11px; }
        """)

    def _open_dashboard_module(self, module_name: str) -> None:
        if module_name == "Home":
            self._dashboard.refresh()
            return

        if module_name == "Exit":
            self.close()
            return

        spec = _MODULE_REGISTRY.get(module_name)
        if spec is None:
            QMessageBox.information(self, module_name, f"{module_name} module is scheduled in the next phase.")
            return

        perm, category, title, view_cls, criteria_note, maximized = spec
        if perm and not self._session.has(perm):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Access Denied", f"Your role does not have permission ({perm}) for {title}.")
            return

        if view_cls is None:
            QMessageBox.information(self, title, f"{title} ({criteria_note}) is ready for service wiring.")
            return

        # Reuse existing window if already open
        existing = self._open_windows.get(title)
        if existing is not None and existing.isVisible():
            existing.raise_()
            existing.activateWindow()
            return

        view = view_cls(self._services, self._session)
        # Apply functional criteria defaults on opened screen
        if module_name == "Account ledger" or module_name == "Ledger":
            tabs = view.findChild(object)
        refresh = getattr(view, "refresh", None)
        if callable(refresh):
            refresh()

        win = VshModuleShellWindow(
            session=self._session,
            title=title,
            category=category,
            content_widget=view,
            criteria_note=criteria_note,
            maximized=maximized,
        )

    def _logout(self) -> None:
        for win in list(self._open_windows.values()):
            win.close()
        self._open_windows.clear()
        self.logged_out.emit()

def resolve_vsh_logo() -> Path | None:
    """PyInstaller-safe logo resolver (ADR-0001 packaging compatible)."""
    bases = []
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False) and hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
        bases.append(Path(sys._MEIPASS))
    bases.append(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3])

    for base in bases:
        for rel in ("assets/vsh_logo.png.png", "assets/vsh_logo.png", "vsh_logo.png.png", "vsh_logo.png"):
            p = base / rel
            if p.exists():
                return p
    return None


def session_role_label(session) -> str:
    roles = getattr(session, "roles", None)
    if roles:
        return ", ".join(str(r) for r in roles)
    perms = getattr(session, "permissions", frozenset())
    if "user.manage" in perms or "account.manage" in perms:
        return "Administrator"
    return "Operator"


class VshModuleShellWindow(QMainWindow):
    """Independent top-level module window with VSH header, role badge, and functional theme."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        session,
        title: str,
        category: str,
        content_widget: QWidget,
        criteria_note: str = "",
        maximized: bool = False,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent=None)
        self._session = session
        theme = FUNCTIONAL_THEMES.get(category, FUNCTIONAL_THEMES["master_data"])

        self.setWindowTitle(f"VSH NEWS TV — {title}")
        self.resize(1340, 840)

        # --- Top Header (Matches Main Dashboard Head & Role Badge) ---
        header = QWidget()
        header.setObjectName("vshModuleHeader")
        header.setFixedHeight(80)
        h_row = QHBoxLayout(header)
        h_row.setContentsMargins(18, 10, 18, 10)
        h_row.setSpacing(14)

        logo = QLabel()
        logo.setFixedSize(58, 58)
        logo.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        logo.setStyleSheet(
            "background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #C8A96B; border-radius: 8px; "
            "color: #4B1427; font-weight: 900; font-size: 11px;"
        )
        logo_path = resolve_vsh_logo()
        if logo_path:
            pix = QPixmap(str(logo_path))
            if not pix.isNull():
                logo.setPixmap(
                    pix.scaled(52, 52, Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio, Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation)
                )
        else:
            logo.setText("VSH\nNEWS")

        title_col = QVBoxLayout()
        title_col.setSpacing(2)
        lbl_top = QLabel(f"VSH NEWS TV  —  {title.upper()}")
        lbl_top.setStyleSheet("color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800;")
        sub_text = "Visionary Baluchistan Media Corporation (Pvt) Ltd"
        if criteria_note:
            sub_text += f"   |   Criteria: {criteria_note}"
        lbl_sub = QLabel(sub_text)
        lbl_sub.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 11px;")
        title_col.addWidget(lbl_top)
        title_col.addWidget(lbl_sub)

        role_box = QLabel(
            f"User ID: {getattr(session, 'username', 'user')}\n"
            f"Role: {session_role_label(session)}"
        )
        role_box.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {theme['badge_bg']}; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #C8A96B; "
            "padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
        )

        self._clock = QLabel()
        self._clock.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
        self._clock.setStyleSheet("color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;")
        self._tick()
        timer = QTimer(self)
        timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        timer.start(1000)

        h_row.addWidget(logo)
        h_row.addLayout(title_col, 1)
        h_row.addWidget(role_box)
        h_row.addWidget(self._clock)

        # --- Functional Body ---
        body = QWidget()
        body.setObjectName("vshFunctionalBody")
        b_lay = QVBoxLayout(body)
        b_lay.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 16, 14)
        b_lay.addWidget(content_widget)

        root = QWidget()
        r_lay = QVBoxLayout(root)
        r_lay.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        r_lay.setSpacing(0)
        r_lay.addWidget(header)
        r_lay.addWidget(body, 1)
        self.setCentralWidget(root)

        status = QStatusBar()
        status.showMessage(
            f"Database: Connected (PostgreSQL)   |   {theme['label']}   |   "
            "VSH NEWS TV — Working for a Better Tomorrow"
        )
        self.setStatusBar(status)

        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QWidget#vshModuleHeader {{ background: {theme['header_bg']}; border-bottom: 3px solid #C8A96B; }}
            QWidget#vshFunctionalBody {{ background: {theme['bg']}; }}
            QTableWidget {{ background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 6px; }}
            QPushButton {{
                background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1;
                padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 5px; font-weight: 600;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{ border-color: {theme['accent']}; }}
            QPushButton#primary {{ background: {theme['accent']}; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; }}
            QStatusBar {{ background: {theme['header_bg']}; color: #F8FAFC; font-size: 11px; }}
        """)

        if maximized:
            self.showMaximized()
        else:
            self.show()

    def _tick(self) -> None:
        now = datetime.now()
        self._clock.setText(now.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p\n%d-%b-%Y"))

from datetime import date

from PySide6.QtCore import QDate
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QComboBox,
    QDateEdit,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTabWidget,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from src.app.ui.support import call_service, fill_table, print_table

_TB_HEADERS = ["Code", "Account", "Debit", "Credit"]
_LG_HEADERS = ["Date", "Voucher", "Narration", "Debit", "Credit", "Balance"]


def _date_edit(qdate: QDate) -> QDateEdit:
    e = QDateEdit(qdate)
    e.setCalendarPopup(True)
    e.setDisplayFormat("dd-MMM-yyyy")
    return e


def _py(e: QDateEdit) -> date:
    d = e.date()
    return date(d.year(), d.month(), d.day())


def _table() -> QTableWidget:
    t = QTableWidget()
    t.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
    return t


def _balance_text(value) -> str:
    return f"{abs(value):,.2f} {'Dr' if value >= 0 else 'Cr'}"


class ReportsView(QWidget):

    def __init__(self, services, session):
        super().__init__()
        self._reports = services.reports
        self._accounts = services.accounts
        self._session = session
        self._tb_rows = []
        self._lg_rows = []

        tabs = QTabWidget()
        tabs.addTab(self._build_trial_balance(), "Trial balance")
        tabs.addTab(self._build_ledger(), "Account ledger")
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(tabs)

    # ---- trial balance ----
    def _build_trial_balance(self) -> QWidget:
        self.tb_date = _date_edit(QDate.currentDate())
        run = QPushButton("Run")
        run.setObjectName("primary")
        run.clicked.connect(self._run_tb)
        pdf = QPushButton("PDF")
        pdf.clicked.connect(lambda: self._print_tb(True))
        prn = QPushButton("Print")
        prn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._print_tb(False))
        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        bar.addWidget(QLabel("As of"))
        bar.addWidget(self.tb_date)
        bar.addWidget(run)
        bar.addStretch()
        bar.addWidget(pdf)
        bar.addWidget(prn)
        self.tb_table = _table()
        self.tb_total = QLabel()
        w = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        lay.addLayout(bar)
        lay.addWidget(self.tb_table)
        lay.addWidget(self.tb_total)
        return w

    def _tb_data(self):
        data = [(r.code, r.name, r.debit, r.credit) for r in self._tb_rows]
        if self._tb_rows:
            data.append(("", "TOTAL", sum(r.debit for r in self._tb_rows),
                         sum(r.credit for r in self._tb_rows)))
        return data

    def _run_tb(self) -> None:
        ok, rows = call_service(self, self._reports.trial_balance, self._session,
                                _py(self.tb_date))
        if ok:
            self._tb_rows = rows
            data = self._tb_data()
            fill_table(self.tb_table, _TB_HEADERS, data)
            if rows:
                d, c = data[-1][2], data[-1][3]
                self.tb_total.setText(f"Total debit {d:,.2f}   Total credit {c:,.2f}")
            else:
                self.tb_total.setText("No posted entries up to this date.")

    def _print_tb(self, to_pdf: bool) -> None:
        print_table(self, "Trial balance", _TB_HEADERS, self._tb_data(),
                    subtitle=f"As of {_py(self.tb_date):%d-%b-%Y}", right_cols=(2, 3),
                    to_pdf=to_pdf)

    # ---- ledger ----
    def _build_ledger(self) -> QWidget:
        self.lg_account = QComboBox()
        today = QDate.currentDate()
        self.lg_from = _date_edit(QDate(today.year(), 1, 1))
        self.lg_to = _date_edit(today)
        run = QPushButton("Run")
        run.setObjectName("primary")
        run.clicked.connect(self._run_ledger)
        pdf = QPushButton("PDF")
        pdf.clicked.connect(lambda: self._print_ledger(True))
        prn = QPushButton("Print")
        prn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._print_ledger(False))
        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        for widget in (QLabel("Account"), self.lg_account, QLabel("From"), self.lg_from,
                       QLabel("To"), self.lg_to, run):
            bar.addWidget(widget)
        bar.addStretch()
        bar.addWidget(pdf)
        bar.addWidget(prn)
        self.lg_table = _table()
        w = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        lay.addLayout(bar)
        lay.addWidget(self.lg_table)
        return w

    def _lg_data(self):
        return [(r.entry_date, r.voucher_no, r.narration, r.debit, r.credit,
                 _balance_text(r.balance)) for r in self._lg_rows]

    def _run_ledger(self) -> None:
        account_id = self.lg_account.currentData()
        if account_id is None:
            return
        ok, rows = call_service(self, self._reports.account_ledger, self._session,
                                account_id, _py(self.lg_from), _py(self.lg_to))
        if ok:
            self._lg_rows = rows
            fill_table(self.lg_table, _LG_HEADERS, self._lg_data(), right_cols=(5,))

    def _print_ledger(self, to_pdf: bool) -> None:
        sub = (f"{self.lg_account.currentText()}  |  "
               f"{_py(self.lg_from):%d-%b-%Y} to {_py(self.lg_to):%d-%b-%Y}")
        print_table(self, "Account ledger", _LG_HEADERS, self._lg_data(), subtitle=sub,
                    right_cols=(3, 4, 5), to_pdf=to_pdf)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        ok, accounts = call_service(self, self._accounts.list_accounts, self._session)
        if ok:
            self.lg_account.clear()
            for a in accounts:
                self.lg_account.addItem(f"{a.code} - {a.name}", a.id)

"""Shared UI helpers: filling tables, printing tables with official VSH logo header,
and calling services with friendly error messages."""
import base64
import html
import logging
import sys
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QPageSize, QTextDocument
from PySide6.QtPrintSupport import QPrintDialog, QPrinter
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog,
    QFileDialog,
    QMessageBox,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
)

from src.app.application.services.account_service import AccountError
from src.app.application.services.permission_service import PermissionDenied
from src.app.application.services.posting_service import PostingError
from src.app.application.services.voucher_service import VoucherError

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
USER_ERRORS = (VoucherError, PermissionDenied, PostingError, AccountError)
_RIGHT = Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter


def _logo_data_uri() -> str:
    """Resolve official VSH NEWS logo from assets/ (supports source & PyInstaller bundle)."""
    bases = []
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False) and hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
        bases.append(Path(sys._MEIPASS))
    bases.extend([Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3], Path.cwd()])
    for base in bases:
        for rel in ("assets/vsh_logo.png.png", "assets/vsh_logo.png", "vsh_logo.png.png"):
            p = base / rel
            if p.exists():
                encoded = base64.b64encode(p.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
                return f"data:image/png;base64,{encoded}"
    return ""


def fmt(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return f"{value:,.2f}"
    if isinstance(value, (date, datetime)):
        return value.strftime("%d-%b-%Y")
    return str(value)


def fill_table(table: QTableWidget, headers, rows, right_cols=()) -> None:
    table.clear()
    table.setColumnCount(len(headers))
    table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(list(headers))
    table.setRowCount(len(rows))
    for r, row in enumerate(rows):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            item = QTableWidgetItem(fmt(value))
            if c in right_cols or isinstance(value, Decimal):
                item.setTextAlignment(_RIGHT)
            table.setItem(r, c, item)
    table.resizeColumnsToContents()
    table.horizontalHeader().setStretchLastSection(True)


def _html(title, subtitle, headers, rows, right_cols):
    logo_uri = _logo_data_uri()
    logo_cell = (
        f'<td width="76"><img src="{logo_uri}" width="64" height="64" /></td>'
        if logo_uri else ""
    )
    head = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(h)}</th>" for h in headers)
    body = ""
    for row in rows:
        cells = ""
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            align = ' align="right"' if (c in right_cols or isinstance(value, Decimal)) else ""
            cells += f"<td{align}>{html.escape(fmt(value))}</td>"
        body += f"<tr>{cells}</tr>"
    return (
        '<table width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="6" '
        'style="border-bottom:2px solid #DC2626; margin-bottom:10px;">'
        f"<tr>{logo_cell}"
        "<td>"
        '<div style="font-size:17pt; font-weight:bold; color:#991B1B;">VSH NEWS TV</div>'
        '<div style="font-size:10pt; color:#334155;">Visionary Baluchistan Media Corporation (Pvt) Ltd</div>'
        f'<div style="font-size:13pt; font-weight:bold; color:#0F172A; margin-top:4px;">{html.escape(title)}</div>'
        f'<div style="font-size:9pt; color:#475569;">{html.escape(subtitle)}</div>'
        "</td></tr></table>"
        '<table border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="4" width="100%">'
        f"<thead><tr bgcolor='#fee2e2'>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>{body}</tbody></table>"
    )


def print_table(parent, title, headers, rows, subtitle="", right_cols=(), to_pdf=False) -> None:
    """Print (or save as PDF) a table with official VSH NEWS logo header."""
    printer = QPrinter(QPrinter.PrinterMode.HighResolution)
    printer.setPageSize(QPageSize(QPageSize.PageSizeId.A4))
    if to_pdf:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(parent, "Save PDF", f"{title}.pdf", "PDF (*.pdf)")
        if not path:
            return
        printer.setOutputFormat(QPrinter.OutputFormat.PdfFormat)
        printer.setOutputFileName(path)
    elif QPrintDialog(printer, parent).exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
        return
    doc = QTextDocument()
    doc.setHtml(_html(title, subtitle, headers, rows, right_cols))
    doc.print_(printer)


def call_service(parent, fn, *args, **kwargs):
    """Run a service call. Returns (True, result) or (False, None) after
    showing a message; business errors are shown, unexpected ones logged."""
    try:
        return True, fn(*args, **kwargs)
    except USER_ERRORS as ex:
        QMessageBox.warning(parent, "Not allowed", str(ex))
    except Exception:
        log.exception("Unexpected error in %s", getattr(fn, "__name__", fn))
        QMessageBox.critical(parent, "Error",
                             "Something went wrong. Details were written to the log file.")
    return False, None

    def load_users(self):
        """
        Load users from UserService.
        """

        users = []

        try:
            users = self.user_service.get_all_users()

        except Exception as ex:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Users",
                str(ex),
            )

        self.table.setRowCount(len(users))

        for row, user in enumerate(users):

            self.table.setItem(
                row,
                0,
                QTableWidgetItem(
                    str(user.get("username", ""))
                ),
            )

            self.table.setItem(
                row,
                1,
                QTableWidgetItem(
                    str(user.get("employee_name", ""))
                ),
            )

            self.table.setItem(

                ),
            )

            self.table.setItem(

                3,
                QTableWidgetItem(
                    "Active"
                    if user.get("is_active")
                    else "Disabled"
                ),
            )

            self.table.setItem(
                row,
                4,
                QTableWidgetItem(
                    str(user.get("last_login", ""))
                ),
            )

            self.table.setItem(
                row,
                5,
                QTableWidgetItem(
                    "Yes"
                    if user.get("must_change_password")
                    else "No"
                ),
            )

    def filter_users(self):
        text = self.search_edit.text().lower()

        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            username_item = self.table.item(row, 0)

            if username_item is None:
                continue

            visible = (
                text in username_item.text().lower()
            )

            self.table.setRowHidden(
                row,
                not visible,
            )

    def selected_username(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()

        if row < 0:
            return None

        item = self.table.item(row, 0)

        if item:
            return item.text()

        return None

    def add_user(self):
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Users",

        )

    def edit_user(self):
        username = self.selected_username()

        if not username:

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Users",
            f"Edit User: {username}",
        )

    def reset_password(self):
        username = self.selected_username()

        if not username:

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Users",
            f"Reset Password: {username}",
        )

    def disable_user(self):
        username = self.selected_username()

        if not username:
            return

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Users",
            f"Disable User: {username}",
        )

    def assign_role(self):
        username = self.selected_username()

        if not username:
            return

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Users",
            f"Assign Role: {username}",
        )

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

from PySide6.QtCore import QDate, QRegularExpression
from PySide6.QtGui import QRegularExpressionValidator
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QComboBox,
    QDateEdit,
    QDialog,
    QDialogButtonBox,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

_ZERO = Decimal("0")


def _amount(edit: QLineEdit) -> Decimal:
    try:
        return Decimal(edit.text().strip() or "0")
    except InvalidOperation:
        return _ZERO


class VoucherDialog(QDialog):
    """Voucher entry form. Returns plain values; the service validates them."""

    def __init__(self, accounts, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("New voucher")
        self.resize(760, 480)
        self._accounts = accounts

        self.date = QDateEdit(QDate.currentDate())
        self.date.setCalendarPopup(True)
        self.date.setDisplayFormat("dd-MMM-yyyy")
        self.narration = QLineEdit()
        form = QFormLayout()
        form.addRow("Date", self.date)
        form.addRow("Narration", self.narration)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 3)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Account", "Debit", "Credit"])
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)

        add = QPushButton("Add line")
        add.clicked.connect(self.add_row)
        remove = QPushButton("Remove selected line")
        remove.clicked.connect(self._remove_row)
        tools = QHBoxLayout()
        tools.addWidget(add)
        tools.addWidget(remove)
        tools.addStretch()

        self.summary = QLabel()
        self.buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        self.buttons.accepted.connect(self.accept)
        self.buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addLayout(form)
        layout.addWidget(self.table)
        layout.addLayout(tools)
        layout.addWidget(self.summary)
        layout.addWidget(self.buttons)

        self.add_row()
        self.add_row()

    def add_row(self) -> None:
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        combo = QComboBox()
        combo.addItem("Select account...", None)
        for a in self._accounts:
            combo.addItem(f"{a.code} - {a.name}", a.id)
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._refresh)
        self.table.setCellWidget(row, 0, combo)
        validator = QRegularExpressionValidator(QRegularExpression(r"^\d{0,12}(\.\d{0,2})?$"))
        for col in (1, 2):
            edit = QLineEdit()
            edit.setValidator(validator)
            edit.setPlaceholderText("0.00")
            edit.textChanged.connect(self._refresh)
            self.table.setCellWidget(row, col, edit)
        self._refresh()

    def _remove_row(self) -> None:
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            self.table.removeRow(row)
            self._refresh()

    def _read(self):
        lines, ok = [], True
        for r in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            account_id = self.table.cellWidget(r, 0).currentData()
            debit = _amount(self.table.cellWidget(r, 1))
            credit = _amount(self.table.cellWidget(r, 2))
            if debit == 0 and credit == 0:
                continue
            if account_id is None or (debit > 0) == (credit > 0):
                ok = False
            lines.append({"account_id": account_id, "debit": debit, "credit": credit})
        return lines, ok

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        lines, ok = self._read()
        debit = sum((l["debit"] for l in lines), _ZERO)
        credit = sum((l["credit"] for l in lines), _ZERO)
        balanced = ok and len(lines) >= 2 and debit == credit and debit > 0
        self.summary.setText(
            f"Debit {debit:,.2f}   Credit {credit:,.2f}   Difference {debit - credit:,.2f}"
        )
        self.summary.setObjectName("ok" if balanced else "bad")
        self.summary.style().unpolish(self.summary)
        self.summary.style().polish(self.summary)
        self.buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok).setEnabled(balanced)

    def values(self) -> dict:
        lines, _ = self._read()
        d = self.date.date()
        return {
            "voucher_date": date(d.year(), d.month(), d.day()),
            "narration": self.narration.text().strip(),
            "lines": lines,
        }

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (

from src.app.domain.security import permissions as P
from src.app.domain.workflow import TRANSITIONS, can_transition
from src.app.ui.support import call_service, fill_table, print_table
from src.app.ui.voucher_dialog import VoucherDialog

_HEADERS = ["No.", "Date", "Narration", "Status", "Debit", "Credit"]


def _table() -> QTableWidget:
    t = QTableWidget()
    t.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
    t.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    t.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
    return t


class VouchersView(QWidget):

    def __init__(self, services, session):
        super().__init__()
        self._vouchers = services.vouchers
        self._accounts = services.accounts
        self._session = session
        self._rows = []

        self.status_filter = QComboBox()
        self.status_filter.addItems(["All", *TRANSITIONS])
        self.status_filter.currentIndexChanged.connect(self.refresh)

        self.btn_new = self._button("New voucher", self._new, primary=True)
        self.btn_submit = self._button("Submit", lambda: self._move("submit"))
        self.btn_approve = self._button("Approve", lambda: self._move("approve"))
        self.btn_back = self._button("Return to draft", lambda: self._move("return_to_draft"))
        self.btn_post = self._button("Post", lambda: self._move("post", confirm=True))
        self.btn_reverse = self._button("Reverse", lambda: self._move("reverse", confirm=True))
        self.btn_print = self._button("Print list", self._print)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        bar.addWidget(QLabel("Status"))
        bar.addWidget(self.status_filter)
        bar.addStretch()
        for b in (self.btn_new, self.btn_submit, self.btn_approve, self.btn_back,
                  self.btn_post, self.btn_reverse, self.btn_print):
            bar.addWidget(b)

        self.table = _table()
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._on_select)
        self.detail = _table()

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addLayout(bar)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 3)
        layout.addWidget(QLabel("Lines of the selected voucher"))
        layout.addWidget(self.detail, 2)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _button(self, text, handler, primary=False):
        b = QPushButton(text)
        if primary:
            b.setObjectName("primary")
        b.clicked.connect(handler)
        return b

    def _selected(self):
        r = self.table.currentRow()
        return self._rows[r] if 0 <= r < len(self._rows) else None

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        status = self.status_filter.currentText()
        ok, rows = call_service(self, self._vouchers.list_vouchers, self._session,
                                None if status == "All" else status)
        self._rows = rows if ok else []
        fill_table(self.table, _HEADERS,
                   [(v.voucher_no, v.voucher_date, v.narration or "", v.status,
                     v.debit, v.credit) for v in self._rows])
        self.detail.clear()
        self.detail.setRowCount(0)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_select(self) -> None:
        self._update_buttons()
        v = self._selected()
        if v is None:
            return
        ok, detail = call_service(self, self._vouchers.get_voucher, self._session, v.id)
        if ok:
            fill_table(self.detail, ["Account code", "Account", "Debit", "Credit"],
                       [(l.account_code, l.account_name, l.debit, l.credit)
                        for l in detail.lines])

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        s = self._session
        v = self._selected()
        status = v.status if v else None

        def allowed(target, perm):
            return bool(status) and s.has(perm) and can_transition(status, target)

        self.btn_new.setEnabled(s.has(P.VOUCHER_CREATE))
        self.btn_submit.setEnabled(allowed("Submitted", P.VOUCHER_SUBMIT))
        self.btn_approve.setEnabled(allowed("Approved", P.VOUCHER_APPROVE))
        self.btn_back.setEnabled(allowed("Draft", P.VOUCHER_APPROVE))
        self.btn_post.setEnabled(allowed("Posted", P.VOUCHER_POST))
        self.btn_reverse.setEnabled(allowed("Reversed", P.VOUCHER_REVERSE))
        self.btn_print.setEnabled(bool(self._rows))

    def _new(self) -> None:
        ok, accounts = call_service(self, self._accounts.list_accounts, self._session)
        if not ok:
            return
        if not accounts:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No accounts",
                                    "Create at least two accounts before entering vouchers.")
            return
        dialog = VoucherDialog(accounts, self)
        if dialog.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            ok, _ = call_service(self, self._vouchers.create_draft, self._session,
                                 **dialog.values())
            if ok:
                self.refresh()

    def _move(self, action: str, confirm: bool = False) -> None:
        v = self._selected()
        if v is None:
            return
        if confirm and QMessageBox.question(
            self, "Confirm", f"{action.capitalize()} voucher {v.voucher_no}?"
        ) != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        ok, _ = call_service(self, getattr(self._vouchers, action), self._session, v.id)
        if ok:
            self.refresh()

    def _print(self) -> None:
        rows = [(v.voucher_no, v.voucher_date, v.narration or "", v.status, v.debit, v.credit)
                for v in self._rows]
        print_table(self, "Vouchers", _HEADERS, rows, right_cols=(4, 5))

import pytest

from src.app.application.services.posting_service import (
    PostingService,
    PostingError,
)


class Voucher:

    def __init__(
        self,
        status,
        period_closed=False,
        debits=100,
        credits=100,
    ):
        self.status = status
        self.period_closed = period_closed
        self.debits = debits
        self.credits = credits


def test_only_approved_vouchers_can_be_posted():

    voucher = Voucher("Draft")

    with pytest.raises(PostingError):
        PostingService.post_voucher(
            voucher,
            {"voucher.post"},
        )


def test_posting_changes_status():

    voucher = Voucher("Approved")

    result = PostingService.post_voucher(
        voucher,
        {"voucher.post"},
    )

    assert result == "Posted"


def test_closed_period_cannot_post():

    voucher = Voucher(
        "Approved",
        period_closed=True,
    )

    with pytest.raises(PostingError):
        PostingService.post_voucher(
            voucher,
            {"voucher.post"},
        )


def test_unbalanced_voucher_cannot_post():

    voucher = Voucher(
        "Approved",
        debits=100,
        credits=50,
    )

    with pytest.raises(PostingError):
        PostingService.post_voucher(
            voucher,
            {"voucher.post"},
        )

"""Runs the real services against PostgreSQL inside ONE outer transaction that
is rolled back at the end, so erp_office is left untouched.
Skipped automatically if the database is unreachable or 0006 is not applied."""
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

import psycopg
import pytest

from src.app.application.services.account_service import AccountService
from src.app.application.services.permission_service import PermissionDenied
from src.app.application.services.report_service import ReportService
from src.app.application.services.voucher_service import VoucherError, VoucherService
from src.app.application.session import Session
from src.app.domain.security import permissions as P
from src.app.infrastructure.database.connection import get_connection
from src.app.infrastructure.database.unit_of_work import UnitOfWork


@pytest.fixture
def conn():
    try:
        c = get_connection()
    except Exception as ex:
        pytest.skip(f"database not reachable: {ex}")
    c.execute("SELECT 1")                      # open the outer transaction
    version = c.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version").fetchone()[0]
    if version < 6:
        c.close()
        pytest.skip("run tools\\migrate.py first (0006 not applied)")
    yield c
    c.rollback()
    c.close()


@pytest.fixture
def env(conn):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1").fetchone()
    if row is None:
        pytest.skip("no user in the database")
    factory = lambda: UnitOfWork(connection=conn)       # noqa: E731
    session = Session(row[0], "tester", frozenset(P.ALL))
    return conn, factory, session


def test_full_voucher_lifecycle(env):
    conn, factory, session = env
    accounts, vouchers, reports = (AccountService(factory), VoucherService(factory),
                                   ReportService(factory))
    cash = accounts.create_account(session, "T-1001", "Test cash", "Asset")
    sales = accounts.create_account(session, "T-4001", "Test sales", "Income")

    vid = vouchers.create_draft(session, date.today(), "test sale", [
        {"account_id": cash, "debit": "250.00", "credit": "0"},
        {"account_id": sales, "debit": "0", "credit": "250.00"},
    ])
    with pytest.raises(VoucherError):                      # cannot skip approval
        vouchers.post(session, vid)

    vouchers.submit(session, vid)
    vouchers.approve(session, vid)
    vouchers.post(session, vid)

    tb = {r.code: r for r in reports.trial_balance(session, date.today())}
    assert tb["T-1001"].debit == Decimal("250.00")
    assert tb["T-4001"].credit == Decimal("250.00")

    vouchers.reverse(session, vid)
    tb = {r.code: r for r in reports.trial_balance(session, date.today())}
    assert tb["T-1001"].debit == 0 and tb["T-4001"].credit == 0
    assert vouchers.get_voucher(session, vid).header.status == "Reversed"

    actions = [r[0] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT action FROM audit_log WHERE entity = 'voucher' AND entity_id = %s ORDER BY id",
        (vid,)).fetchall()]
    assert actions == ["voucher.create", "voucher.submit", "voucher.approve",
                       "voucher.post", "voucher.reverse"]


def test_ledger_is_append_only(env):
    conn, factory, session = env
    accounts, vouchers = AccountService(factory), VoucherService(factory)
    a = accounts.create_account(session, "T-1002", "Test A", "Asset")
    b = accounts.create_account(session, "T-4002", "Test B", "Income")
    vid = vouchers.create_draft(session, date.today(), "x", [
        {"account_id": a, "debit": "10", "credit": "0"},
        {"account_id": b, "debit": "0", "credit": "10"},
    ])
    vouchers.submit(session, vid)
    vouchers.approve(session, vid)
    vouchers.post(session, vid)
    with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.RaiseException):
        with conn.transaction():
            conn.execute("UPDATE journal_lines SET debit = debit + 1")


def test_missing_permission_is_refused(env):

    weak = Session(session.user_id, "weak", frozenset({P.VOUCHER_VIEW}))
    with pytest.raises(PermissionDenied):
        VoucherService(factory).post(weak, 1)

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from src.app.domain.accounting.chart import ACCOUNT_TYPES, normal_balance_for
from src.app.domain.accounting.journal import (
    JournalError,
    make_line,
    reverse_lines,
    validate_balanced,
)


def test_line_needs_exactly_one_side():
    with pytest.raises(JournalError):
        make_line(1, "10", "10")
    with pytest.raises(JournalError):
        make_line(1, "0", "0")


def test_line_rejects_negative_and_float():
    with pytest.raises(JournalError):
        make_line(1, "-5", "0")
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        make_line(1, 10.5, "0")


def test_balanced_voucher_returns_total():
    lines = [make_line(1, "100.00", "0"), make_line(2, "0", "100.00")]
    assert validate_balanced(lines) == Decimal("100.00")


def test_unbalanced_voucher_is_rejected():
    lines = [make_line(1, "100", "0"), make_line(2, "0", "99.99")]
    with pytest.raises(JournalError):
        validate_balanced(lines)


def test_single_line_voucher_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(JournalError):
        validate_balanced([make_line(1, "100", "0")])


def test_reverse_swaps_sides_and_stays_balanced():
    lines = [make_line(1, "75", "0"), make_line(2, "0", "75")]
    reversed_ = reverse_lines(lines)
    assert reversed_[0].credit == Decimal("75.00") and reversed_[0].debit == 0
    assert validate_balanced(reversed_) == Decimal("75.00")


def test_normal_balance_by_type():
    assert normal_balance_for("Asset") == "D"
    assert normal_balance_for("Income") == "C"
    assert set(ACCOUNT_TYPES) == {"Asset", "Liability", "Equity", "Income", "Expense"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        normal_balance_for("Other")

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from src.app.application.services.posting_service import PostingError
from src.app.application.services.voucher_service import VoucherError, VoucherService
from src.app.application.session import Session

class _VoucherRepository:
    def get_header(self, voucher_id, lock=False):
        return {"status": "Draft"}

    def get_lines(self, voucher_id):
        return [
            {"account_id": 1, "debit": Decimal("10"), "credit": Decimal("0")},
            {"account_id": 2, "debit": Decimal("0"), "credit": Decimal("10")},
        ]


class _UnitOfWork:
    def __init__(self):
        self.vouchers = _VoucherRepository()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        return False


def test_post_translates_posting_error_to_voucher_error():
    service = VoucherService(_UnitOfWork)
    session = Session(1, "tester", frozenset({P.VOUCHER_POST}))

    with pytest.raises(VoucherError, match="Only approved vouchers can be posted") as error:
        service.post(session, 1)

    assert isinstance(error.value.__cause__, PostingError)

(ROOT / "src/app/main.py").write_text('''import logging
import sys

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox

from src.app.bootstrap import build_services, start_logging
from src.app.ui.login_window import LoginWindow
from src.app.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from src.app.ui.style import apply_style

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Shell:
    """Owns the top-level windows: login <-> main."""

    def __init__(self, services):
        self._services = services
        self._main = None
        self.login = LoginWindow(services.auth)
        self.login.authenticated.connect(self._open_main)

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self._main is not None:
            self._main.hide()
            self._main.close()
            self._main.deleteLater()
            self._main = None
        self.login.reset()
        self.login.show()
        self.login.raise_()
        self.login.activateWindow()

    def _open_main(self, session) -> None:
        self._main = MainWindow(self._services, session)
        self._main.logged_out.connect(self.start)
        self._main.show()
        self.login.hide()


def _excepthook(exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
    log.critical("Unhandled error", exc_info=(exc_type, exc, tb))
    QMessageBox.critical(None, "Unexpected error",
                         "The application hit an unexpected error. Details were written to the log.")


def main() -> int:
    start_logging()
    sys.excepthook = _excepthook
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    apply_style(app)
    shell = Shell(build_services())
    shell.start()
    return app.exec()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
''', encoding="utf-8")

# Builds the installer, enforcing ADR-0001 sections 1-3. Run from anywhere:
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\build_exe.ps1
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
Set-Location $root
$py = Join-Path $root "venv\Scripts\python.exe"

# --- ADR-0001 s.2: Python 3.12, 64-bit
if (-not (Test-Path $py)) { throw "venv not found at $py" }
$info = (& $py -c "import sys,struct;print(sys.version_info[0],sys.version_info[1],struct.calcsize('P')*8)").Trim()
if ($info -ne "3 12 64") { throw "ADR-0001 requires Python 3.12 64-bit (found: $info)" }

# --- ADR-0001 s.1: WSL2 (warn only; it is a platform requirement, not a build one)

import os

import psycopg

print(".env exists:", Path(".env").exists())

    conn = psycopg.connect(
        host=os.environ["DB_HOST"],
        port=os.environ["DB_PORT"],
        dbname=os.environ["DB_NAME"],
        user=os.environ["DB_USER"],
        password=os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"],
    )
except KeyError as e:
    print("Missing setting in .env:", e)
    raise SystemExit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print("Connection FAILED:", type(e).__name__)
    print(str(e).strip().splitlines()[0])
    raise SystemExit(1)

row = conn.execute("select current_user, current_database()").fetchone()
print("Connected as:", row)
tables = [r[0] for r in conn.execute(
    "select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public' order by 1")]
print("Tables in public:", tables)
conn.close()

"""Verifies the tables/columns the new code relies on, and compares the
permission codes in the database with src/app/domain/security/permissions.py.
Run BEFORE migrate.py:  python tools\\"""
from src.app.domain.security import permissions as P
from src.app.infrastructure.database.connection import get_connection

EXPECTED = {
    "users": {"id", "username", "password_hash", "is_active", "must_change_password"},
    "permissions": {"id", "code"},
    "role_permissions": {"role_id", "permission_id"},
    "user_roles": {"user_id", "role_id"},
    "accounts": {"id", "code", "name", "type", "normal_balance", "is_active"},
    "voucher_headers": {"id", "voucher_no", "voucher_date", "narration", "status"},
    "voucher_lines": {"id", "voucher_id", "account_id", "debit", "credit"},
}


def main() -> int:
    bad = False
    with get_connection() as conn:
        cols: dict[str, set] = {}
        for table, column in conn.execute(
            "SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns "
            "WHERE table_schema = 'public'"
        ):
            cols.setdefault(table, set()).add(column)

        for table, wanted in EXPECTED.items():
            missing = wanted - cols.get(table, set())
            print(f"[{'FAIL' if missing else ' ok '}] {table}"
                  + (f"  missing: {sorted(missing)}" if missing else ""))
            bad |= bool(missing)

        applied = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"\nschema_version = {applied} (run tools\\migrate.py until it reaches 6)")

        if "code" in cols.get("permissions", set()):
            have = {r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT code FROM permissions")}
            print("\nPermission codes in database:", ", ".join(sorted(have)) or "(none)")
            missing = [c for c in P.ALL if c not in have]
            if missing:
                print("\nNot in database (the app uses these codes):")
                for c in missing:
                    print("  -", c)
                print("\nEither rename the constants in domain/security/permissions.py to match "
                      "your existing codes, or INSERT the missing ones and grant them to a role.")
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from getpass import getpass
from argon2 import PasswordHasher
from src.app.infrastructure.database.connection import get_connection

print("\n===== ERP FIRST ADMIN ACCOUNT SETUP =====")

username = input("Enter username [admin]: ").strip() or "admin"
full_name = input("Enter administrator full name: ").strip()

if not full_name:
    raise SystemExit("Full name is required.")

password = getpass("Enter your password: ")
confirm = getpass("Confirm your password: ")

if password != confirm:
    raise SystemExit("Passwords do not match.")

if len(password) < 12:
    raise SystemExit("Password must contain at least 12 characters.")

password_hash = PasswordHasher().hash(password)

with get_connection() as conn:
    with conn.transaction():
        if conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = %s", (username,)
        ).fetchone():
            raise SystemExit("Username already exists.")

        role = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = 'Admin'"
        ).fetchone()

        if not role:
            raise SystemExit("Admin role not found.")

        user_id = conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO users
                (username, full_name, password_hash, is_active,
                 must_change_password)
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s, TRUE, TRUE)
            RETURNING id
            """,
            (username, full_name, password_hash)
        ).fetchone()[0]

        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) VALUES (%s, %s)",
            (user_id, role[0])
        )

print("\nADMIN ACCOUNT CREATED SUCCESSFULLY")
print("Username:", username)
print("User ID:", user_id)
print("Role: Admin")

# tools\project_report.ps1
# Read-only status report for C:\Mohsin_Vsh_News.tv
# Writes docs\project_status_report.md and prints it. Changes nothing.
# Run from the project root, in the VS Code terminal with .venv activated:
#   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tools\project_report.ps1
# Add -SkipDb to skip the database section (no password prompt).

param([switch]$SkipDb)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Set-Location $root

$out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
function Add-Line([string]$t) { $out.Add($t) }
function Add-Section([string]$t) { $out.Add(""); $out.Add("## $t"); $out.Add("") }
function Add-Block($lines) {
    $out.Add('```')
    foreach ($l in @($lines)) { $out.Add([string]$l) }
    $out.Add('```')
}

Add-Line "# Mohsin_Vsh_News.tv - project status report"
Add-Line ""
Add-Line "Generated: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')  |  Folder: $root"

# 1. Tools -------------------------------------------------------------------
Add-Section "1. Tools"
$tools = @()
$tools += "python : " + ((python --version 2>&1) -join ' ')
$cmd = Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($cmd) { $tools += "python path : " + $cmd.Source }
$tools += "psql   : " + ((psql --version 2>&1) -join ' ')
$iscc = "C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe"
$tools += "ISCC.exe at default path : " + (Test-Path $iscc)
$prev = [Console]::OutputEncoding
try {
    [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::Unicode
    $wsl = wsl -l -v 2>&1
} finally { [Console]::OutputEncoding = $prev }
$tools += "wsl:"
$tools += ($wsl | ForEach-Object { "  $_" })
Add-Block $tools

Add-Line ""
Add-Line "Key packages in the active environment:"
$pk = python -m pip list --format=freeze 2>&1 |
    Where-Object { $_ -match '^(PySide6==|psycopg|argon2|pytest==|python-dotenv|pyinstaller|xlrd|openpyxl)' }
Add-Block $pk

# 2. Git ---------------------------------------------------------------------
Add-Section "2. Git"
$git = @()
$git += "branch : " + ((git branch --show-current 2>&1) -join ' ')
$git += "tags   : " + ((git tag 2>&1) -join ', ')
$git += ".venv ignored : " + ((git check-ignore .venv 2>&1) -join ' ')
$git += ""
$git += "last commits:"
$git += (git log --oneline -n 10 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "  $_" })
$git += ""
$git += "uncommitted changes (git status --short):"
$st = git status --short 2>&1
if ($st) { $git += ($st | ForEach-Object { "  $_" }) } else { $git += "  (clean)" }
Add-Block $git

# 3. Files -------------------------------------------------------------------
Add-Section "3. Files (src, tests, tools, docs)"
$files = foreach ($d in 'src','tests','tools','docs') {
    if (Test-Path $d) {
        Get-ChildItem $d -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '__pycache__|\.pytest_cache' }
    }
}
$rows = $files | ForEach-Object {
    $rel = $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length + 1)
    $state = if ($_.Length -eq 0) { 'EMPTY' } else { 'has content' }
    '{0,-72} {1,7} bytes  {2}' -f $rel, $_.Length, $state
}
Add-Block $rows
$empty = @($files | Where-Object { $_.Length -eq 0 }).Count
Add-Line ""
Add-Line "Total files: $(@($files).Count)  |  empty: $empty  |  with content: $(@($files).Count - $empty)"

# 4. Migrations --------------------------------------------------------------
Add-Section "4. SQL files"
$sql = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.sql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\\.venv\\|\\archive\\' } |
    ForEach-Object { '{0,-80} {1,7} bytes' -f $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length + 1), $_.Length }
Add-Block $sql

# 5. Tests -------------------------------------------------------------------
Add-Section "5. Tests (pytest -q)"
$t = python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15
Add-Block $t

# 6. Database ----------------------------------------------------------------
Add-Section "6. Database erp_office (read-only queries, as erp_app)"
if ($SkipDb) {
    Add-Line "(skipped with -SkipDb)"
} else {
    $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "project_report_queries.sql"
    @"
\echo --- schema_version
SELECT version, name, applied_at FROM schema_version ORDER BY version;
\echo --- tables and owners
SELECT tablename, tableowner FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename;
\echo --- accounts columns
SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'accounts' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
\echo --- row counts
SELECT 'accounts' AS table_name, count(*) FROM accounts
UNION ALL SELECT 'users', count(*) FROM users
UNION ALL SELECT 'roles', count(*) FROM roles
UNION ALL SELECT 'permissions', count(*) FROM permissions;
"@ | Set-Content -Path $tmp -Encoding ASCII
    Write-Host "psql will ask for the erp_app password (typing is hidden)."
    $db = psql -U erp_app -d erp_office -f $tmp 2>&1
    Remove-Item $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Add-Block $db
}

# Write ----------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force docs | Out-Null
$target = Join-Path $root "docs\project_status_report.md"
$out | Set-Content -Path $target -Encoding UTF8
$out | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }

    ("2000", "Accounts payable", "Liability"),

    ("3000", "Owner's capital", "Equity"),

# 3. Update ReportRepository to return cheque_no, cheque_date, party_name for Statement of Account
(ROOT / "src/app/infrastructure/repositories/report_repository.py").write_text("""from src.app.infrastructure.repositories._sql import fetch_all, fetch_one

_FROM = \"\"\"
    FROM journal_lines jl
    JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.entry_id
    JOIN voucher_headers vh ON vh.id = je.voucher_id
\"\"\"


class ReportRepository:
    def __init__(self, conn):
        self.conn = conn

    def trial_balance(self, as_of) -> list[dict]:
        return fetch_all(
            self.conn,
            \"\"\"SELECT a.code, a.name,
                      GREATEST(SUM(jl.debit) - SUM(jl.credit), 0)  AS debit,
                      GREATEST(SUM(jl.credit) - SUM(jl.debit), 0)  AS credit\"\"\"
            + _FROM
            + \"\"\" JOIN accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
                  WHERE vh.voucher_date <= %s
                  GROUP BY a.code, a.name ORDER BY a.code\"\"\",
            (as_of,),
        )

    def ledger_opening(self, account_id, date_from):
        row = fetch_one(
            self.conn,
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit) - SUM(jl.credit), 0) AS net" + _FROM
            + " WHERE jl.account_id = %s AND vh.voucher_date < %s",
            (account_id, date_from),
        )
        return row["net"]

    def ledger_rows(self, account_id, date_from, date_to) -> list[dict]:
        return fetch_all(
            self.conn,
            \"\"\"SELECT vh.voucher_date AS entry_date,
                      vh.voucher_no,
                      COALESCE(vh.cheque_no, '') AS cheque_no,
                      vh.cheque_date,
                      COALESCE(vh.party_name, '') AS party_name,
                      je.kind,
                      vh.narration,
                      jl.debit,
                      jl.credit\"\"\" + _FROM
            + \"\"\" WHERE jl.account_id = %s AND vh.voucher_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
                  ORDER BY vh.voucher_date, je.id, jl.id\"\"\",
            (account_id, date_from, date_to),
        )
""", encoding="utf-8")

# 7. Update ReportService so account_ledger populates all 9 Statement of Account fields
(ROOT / "src/app/application/services/report_service.py").write_text("""from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from src.app.application.dto import LedgerRow, TrialBalanceRow
from src.app.application.services.permission_service import PermissionService
from src.app.application.session import Session
from src.app.domain.security import permissions as P
from src.app.infrastructure.database.unit_of_work import UnitOfWork
class ReportService:
def init(self, uow_factory=UnitOfWork):
self._uow_factory = uow_factory
def trial_balance(self, session: Session, as_of: date) -> list[TrialBalanceRow]:
PermissionService.require(session.permissions, P.REPORT_VIEW)
with self._uow_factory() as uow:
return [TrialBalanceRow(**r) for r in uow.reports.trial_balance(as_of)]
def account_ledger(self, session: Session, account_id: int,
date_from: date, date_to: date) -> list[LedgerRow]:
PermissionService.require(session.permissions, P.REPORT_VIEW)
with self._uow_factory() as uow:
opening = uow.reports.ledger_opening(account_id, date_from)
rows = uow.reports.ledger_rows(account_id, date_from, date_to)
balance = Decimal(opening)
result = [
LedgerRow(
entry_date=None,
voucher_no="",
narration="Opening balance",
debit=Decimal("0.00"),
credit=Decimal("0.00"),
balance=balance,
cheque_no="",
cheque_date=None,
party_name="",
)
]
for r in rows:
balance += r["debit"] - r["credit"]
prefix = "Reversal of: " if r["kind"] == "Reversal" else ""
result.append(
LedgerRow(
entry_date=r["entry_date"],
voucher_no=r["voucher_no"],
narration=prefix + (r["narration"] or ""),
debit=r["debit"],
credit=r["credit"],
balance=balance,
cheque_no=r.get("cheque_no") or "",
cheque_date=r.get("cheque_date"),
party_name=r.get("party_name") or "",
)
)
return result
